title: Changing Leaders Among Liars — Four Legislators in the Tholos Who Rotate the Writer's Office
description: HotStuff (Yin, Malkhi, Reiter, Gueta and Abraham): four legislators in the Tholos of Schedia, rotating the writer's office at every line of the law scroll, and why one more stage lets a new writer take over as cheaply as an old one.
question: When some machines may lie, replacing a leader has been slow and costly. Can a new leader take over as cheaply as any ordinary step, and at the pace of the messages rather than of a timer?
how: We find out by exploring how four legislators in the Tholos rotated the writer's office at every line of their law scroll, each gathering the others' seals into one bundle instead of sending messengers between every pair of benches.

papers.authors: Maofan Yin, Dahlia Malkhi, Michael K. Reiter, Guy Golan Gueta and Ittai Abraham
papers.title: HotStuff: BFT Consensus with Linearity and Responsiveness
